en: Vintage sepia postcard showing an early biplane on the ground in front of hangars at an airfield. Two men sit in the aircraft's open cockpit, and a large hangar and wooden sheds form the background. At the upper right there is a small circular inset portrait of the pilot in uniform seated at the controls. A green 5 centimes French postage stamp is affixed near the top center, with a circular postmark over it. Red printed captions in French identify the squadron and the aviator.
